summary: Registered question @witness_record_producer to replace the asserted witness-reporting defect's remaining source-only premise with an observation: letting a real replicated state machine build its membership from configuration-change entries so that notifyConfigChange itself stores the witness flag. Traced the entry path that makes this constructible — config-change entries arrive as tasks from the state machine's task queue, are unmarshalled, applied to the membership object and reported to the node proxy — and registered those sources. The experiment needs a task-queue injection plus two ordered config changes, which did not fit this pass, so no execution or interpretation was recorded.
